cards.card_text: A graven image and a molten idol A gold lampstand for the tabernacle A bronze altar for sacrifices
cards.verse_text: And when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, “I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.
cards.snippet: …the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.

cards.card_text: Then she gives two hundred shekels to a silversmith, who makes the graven image and the molten idol.
cards.verse_text: And when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, “I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.

cards.card_text: Once the silversmith makes the graven image and the molten idol, they are placed in Micah's ___.
cards.verse_text: So he returned the silver to his mother, and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into a graven image and a molten idol.
cards.snippet: …silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into a graven image and a molten idol.

cards.card_text: So the priest takes the ephod, the household idols and the graven image and goes along, while the Danites put their small children, livestock and possessions out in front.
cards.verse_text: So the priest was glad and took the ephod, the household idols, and the graven image, and went with the people.
cards.snippet: …priest was glad and took the ephod, the household idols, and the graven image, and went with the people.

cards.card_text: The Danites set up Micah's graven image for themselves.
cards.verse_text: So they set up for themselves Micah’s graven image, and it was there the whole time the house of God was in Shiloh.
cards.snippet: So they set up for themselves Micah’s graven image, and it was there the whole time the house of God…

cards.card_text: It is a land of graven images Its people broke the Sabbath Its people mocked the prophets
cards.verse_text: For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
cards.snippet: For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
